title: Job dependencies
summary: needs makes a job wait for another job to succeed. This states the order between jobs.
introduction: needs makes a job wait for another job to succeed. This states the order between jobs. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: needs makes a job wait for another job to succeed. This states the order between jobs.

blocks.code:
jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Check"
  report:
    needs: check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo "Checks finished"
blocks.title: Job dependencies

blocks.text: The report job depends on check. By default it does not run successfully past a failed needed job.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A dependency does not copy files between jobs.
